# setspeed

Causes Tera Term to change speed of serial port. *(version 4.99 or later)*

```ttl
setspeed <value>
```

This command is a alias of [setbaud](setbaud.md) command.

## Description

Causes Tera Term to change speed of serial port to &lt;value&gt; bps.

## Example

```ttl
; change speed to 115200 bps
setspeed 115200
```

## See also

- [setbaud](setbaud.md)
